content: Common pattern: React Hook Form + Zod resolver for all forms; TanStack Query is best reserved for non-Firestore async calls (HTTP/callable functions) since Firestore onSnapshot already provides its own real-time cache -- syncing onSnapshot into TanStack Query's cache with staleTime Infinity is a known but non-trivial pattern; simpler to keep Firestore listeners in dedicated hooks (or react-firebase-hooks/reactfire) and use TanStack Query only for AI callable-function calls.
